# AnandTech Forums

> > Community-driven technology forums covering hardware reviews, overclocking guides, PC building, troubleshooting, and deal alerts for enthusiasts.

AnandTech Forums is a long-running technology community featuring discussions on PC hardware (AMD, Intel, graphics cards), system building, overclocking techniques, and consumer electronics. The forums include dedicated sections for technical support, hot deals tracking, and off-topic discussions.

## Key Topics

- Hardware troubleshooting
- Overclocking and system optimization
- AMD and ATI graphics cards
- PC building and upgrades
- Motherboard compatibility
- Hot deals and price alerts
- Memtest86+ and Prime95 testing
- Socket 939 and nForce4 platforms
- Windows reinstallation guides
- Monitor and display discussions
- Community polls
- Retail electronics deals
- System stress testing
- BIOS and driver issues
- Gaming hardware

## Hardware Guides and Tutorials

- [Overclocking Guide](https://forums.anandtech.com/threads/overclocking-guide.908): Comprehensive overclocking guide and FAQ for CPU enthusiasts
- [How to: Upgrade your motherboard without reinstalling Windows](https://forums.anandtech.com/threads/how-to-upgrade-your-motherboard-without-reinstalling-windows.1738): Guide for upgrading motherboard while preserving Windows XP installation
- [How to guide: Memtest86+, Prime95, and SP2004](https://forums.anandtech.com/threads/how-to-guide-memtest86-prime95-and-sp2004.3054): Tutorial guide for running Memtest86+, Prime95, and SP2004 stress tests
